apps.title: Connected apps
apps.description: Clients you approved. Removing one ends its access at once.
apps.error: Connected apps could not be loaded
apps.revoke_description: The client loses its connection at once. To connect again you approve it from the start.
apps.failed: The access could not be removed. Try again.
consent.title: Request to connect to ClickFix
consent.invalid: This link is not valid. Start the connection again from your client.
consent.expired: This request expired or was already answered. Start the connection again from your client.
consent.failed: The request could not be processed. Try again.
consent.warning: Only allow a client you started yourself and recognize. The client acts on your behalf in the organization you pick.
consent.no_organization: There is no organization you can connect with MCP. Connecting needs the permission to view settings in the organization; ask your organization admin.
consent.scope_read: It can read the data you are allowed to see.
consent.scope_write: Also allow it to change data (send replies, assign, change status).
consent.write_unavailable: The client also asked to change data, but your permissions in this organization do not allow it; it can only read.
title: Connect with MCP
description: Connect AI clients such as Claude or Cursor to ClickFix. The client sees and does only what your permissions in this organization allow.
forbidden: You do not have permission to connect with MCP. Ask your organization admin for the permission to view settings.
consent.forbidden: You are not allowed to approve this request. Connecting with MCP needs the permission to view settings in the organization.
consent.asks_generic: An application wants to connect to your ClickFix account.
consent.unverified: This is how the application names itself; ClickFix has not verified it.
consent.returns_local: Returns to a program running on this computer.
consent.returns_remote: If you allow, the access code is sent to this web address. Deny if you do not recognize it.
consent.duration: Access lasts {{access}}; the application can renew it for {{renewal}} without asking you again. You can remove the access at any time under Settings → MCP connections.
consent.unsafe_redirect: The decision was saved, but the application's return address is not safe; the browser was not sent there.
error.title: The guide could not be loaded
step1.title: 1. Connection address
step1.description: Give this address to your client. It is the same for everyone; who connects is decided by the approval in the next step.
step2.title: 2. Add it to your client
step2.description: Pick the client you use and copy the configuration. None of them contains a key or a token.
clients.claude.steps: In Claude, open Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector and paste this address.
clients.claude_code.steps: Run this command in a terminal, then start the authorization with /mcp inside Claude Code.
clients.cursor.steps: Add this configuration to Cursor's MCP file; Cursor opens the browser for authorization.
clients.vscode.steps: Add this configuration to the MCP file of your workspace and start the server.
clients.other.steps: For clients that can only start local (stdio) servers, use the mcp-remote bridge; it needs Node.js.
step3.title: 3. Approve in the browser
step3.description: On the first connection the client sends your browser to the ClickFix approval screen.
step3.sign_in: Sign in with your ClickFix account (skipped when you are already signed in).
step3.organization: Pick the organization the client will work in. Access is limited to that organization.
step3.write_allowed: To let the client change data, tick the box on the approval screen; without it the client can only read.
step3.write_denied: Your permissions in this organization allow reading only; the client cannot change data.
step3.no_secret: There is no key or token to copy: the client receives its own access through this approval and keeps it itself. You can remove the access at any time from the list below.
tools.title: Tools you can use
tools.description: Based on your permissions in this organization. The list changes when your permissions do.
tools.none: Your permissions do not allow any tool right now.
tools.unavailable: Tools your permissions do not cover
tools.write_note: "Changes" tools only work when you allowed changing data on the approval screen.
tools.read_only_note: "Changes" tools need the permission to edit organization settings.
